FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Asphalt Solutions Co., we specialize in providing high-quality asphalt paving services for residential driveways and commercial properties. Our operations include site assessments, project planning, surface preparation, asphalt laying, and finishing touches to ensure durability and aesthetic appeal. We pride ourselves on maintaining a fleet of modern, well-maintained equipment to optimize efficiency and safety on the job site. Our team is trained in best practices for heavy equipment operation and adheres to a comprehensive safety program to minimize the risk of workplace accidents. We are committed to environmental compliance and utilize sustainable practices in our paving projects. With a strong emphasis on quality control, we manage all projects directly, ensuring that our clients receive timely and reliable service.

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 06/15/2022; Cause: Damage from heavy rain causing site flooding during paving project; Amount: $5,000; Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday, 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM; closed Sunday.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fireproof safe, Class B, UL labeled
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and security watchpersons employed during paving operations to ensure site safety and security.
